applications.name: OsmAnd
applications.observed: Maps, navigation drawer, route details, and a packaged landscape run were observed in earlier walkthroughs.
applications.limitations: Complete search, routing, downloads, restart persistence, and visual parity remain unverified as a whole.

applications.name: F-Droid
applications.observed: Earlier web-runner testing rendered the main screen.
applications.limitations: Repository refresh and complete app installation workflows are not established.

applications.name: Obtainium
applications.observed: Settings, text input, theme persistence, GitHub release lookup, saved entries, resizing, and manual JSON export/import were exercised.
applications.limitations: Release downloads encounter a storage-path assumption. Installation and clean-state restoration remain unverified.

applications.name: Joplin
applications.observed: Notes list, Add menu, note screen, title entry, and title persistence across restart were verified.
applications.limitations: Body editing is unsupported: the WebView implementation has no JavaScript/DOM engine.

applications.name: SEN-214 Calculator
applications.observed: Basic arithmetic, sin(30), numeric dialog input, and 5P2 were verified.
applications.limitations: Short-window controls overlap; result text may disappear after resize. Full scientific functionality and persistence remain unverified.

applications.name: Lucas Doggiehood
applications.observed: Animated scene, settings, camera drag, zoom, quests, item collection, and reward persistence were verified in successful runs.
applications.limitations: Portrait clipping, intermittent startup stalls, lifecycle timeouts, audio, and longer progression remain open.

applications.name: Unciv
applications.observed: Map interaction, exploration, city founding, save/reload, portrait relayout, research, and Worker production were verified.
applications.limitations: Rendering stability and longer campaigns remain under test. PCM capture does not establish speaker output or audio timing.

applications.name: Abra-Ca Bubble
applications.observed: The ARM64 build reaches an interactive Vulkan requirements warning.
applications.limitations: Vulkan rendering is unsupported; no game scene was verified.

applications.name: SuperTux
applications.observed: Menus, world map, movement, jumping, coin collection, death/restart, resizing, and selected-node restoration were exercised.
applications.limitations: Level completion, campaign persistence, and speaker output remain unverified. Portrait controls overlap.

applications.name: Tiny Crate
applications.observed: Menu, keyboard movement, jumping, first two levels, crate handling, and two-star progress after restart were verified.
applications.limitations: Full touch gameplay, physical audio, clean shutdown, and later levels remain unverified. Portrait rendering uses letterboxing.

applications.name: Mindustry
applications.observed: Campaign world, touch dragging, mining, drill/conveyor construction, core delivery, and saved progress were verified.
applications.limitations: Portrait tutorial text clips. Tutorial completion, combat, and audio remain under test.

applications.name: Ember Quest
applications.observed: Scene, menu, keyboard movement, jumping, Game Over, and Play Again were verified.
applications.limitations: Portrait-to-landscape resize clips the player. Collection, progression, persistence, and audio remain unverified.

applications.name: 2048 (tpcstld)
applications.observed: Upstream 1.3.3 renders the board; pointer swipes move tiles, two 2 tiles merge into 4 and score increases. Landscape relayout works; board, score and high score survive a clean restart.
applications.limitations: A dismissible Google Play Services warning appears on startup and activity recreation. Long games, reaching 2048, Play services features and the current Google Play build remain unverified.
